notes.title: CursedSword Demo Now Live! + Release Date!
notes.notes:
CursedSword Demo Out Now – Full Release April 21, 2025

Hello, fellow rats! 🐀

The CursedSword demo is officially live!
Begin your journey through a hounted island filled with mind-bending puzzles, hidden secrets, and epic battles against the Countess’s fiercest guardians.

Get ready for the full release on April 21, 2025, with even more monsters, secrets, and hundreds of puzzles to conquer.

Wishlist Now & Play the Demo!!
